name: Guinea

latest_census.notes: RGPH-3, March-April 2014 (final results 2017; about 10.5 million). I recall the 2014 questionnaire carrying a religion item, with moderate confidence; the 1996 RGPH-2 asked both religion and ethnicity, and I believe 2014 did too, but ethnicity is politically sensitive in Guinea and I cannot rule out that it was dropped - null rather than a guess. Language: not recalled. A fourth census has been discussed but not, to my knowledge, fielded.

subnational_sources.title: RGPH-3 2014 - Résultats définitifs and thematic analysis reports (INS, 2017): population by région and préfecture, with religion by région if the item was asked
subnational_sources.geography: région (7 administrative regions + Conakry = 8) and préfecture (33 + Conakry = 34)
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 (8) and admin2 (34) exactly, for whatever the reports tabulate at those levels
subnational_sources.evidence: The 2014 definitive results are published as PDF volumes on stat-guinee.org; population by préfecture is certain, religion by région is my recollection, religion by préfecture unknown.

subnational_sources.title: IPUMS-International - Guinea 1983, 1996, 2014 census samples
subnational_sources.evidence: The 1996 sample carries religion and ethnicity; I believe the 2014 sample does as well. If so this is the only route I can name to the 34 prefectures.

subnational_sources.title: Enquête Démographique et de Santé (EDS-V / DHS 2018): respondents' religion and ethnicity by region
subnational_sources.evidence: Standard DHS background-characteristics tables (women 15-49 and men 15-59) give religion and ethnic group by region. A survey, ranked below any count, but with a far larger regional sample than Afrobarometer R9.

tier_reason: A 2014 census exists whose questionnaire I believe carried religion, published by region (8 = admin1) as PDF, with the 34 prefectures (= admin2 exactly) reachable only via registered IPUMS microdata; my confidence is the lowest in this batch and a runner must confirm the questionnaire before anything is built.
recommended_action: Crawl stat-guinee.org for the RGPH-3 2014 definitive-results volumes and thematic reports; confirm from the questionnaire or the tables whether religion and ethnicity were asked. If religion by région is there, read it with probe_pdf.py and replace the Afrobarometer R9 survey on the 8 admin1 rows (owner review). For the 34 préfectures, request the IPUMS 2014 sample. If the census asked neither, the DHS 2018 regional tables are the better survey, and ethnicity/religion become not_collected declarations citing the 2014 questionnaire.
not_found: confirmation that RGPH-3 2014 asked religion and/or ethnicity (moderate recollection only)
any table of religion or ethnicity by préfecture
any XLSX/CSV release from INS Guinée
whether a fourth census has been fielded since 2014
summary: Guinea's INS (stat-guinee.org) ran its last census in 2014 (RGPH-3) and publishes the definitive results as PDF volumes by the 8 regions (= admin1) and 34 prefectures (= admin2 exactly); I recall a religion item and possibly ethnicity, but a runner must verify the questionnaire. The 34 prefectures are otherwise reachable only through IPUMS-International's 2014 sample. Tier B with low confidence; a confirmed census read would replace the Afrobarometer survey on admin1, and the 2018 DHS is the better survey fallback.
